summary: Gone lookout named Skeetrock, listed with unknown type in Dickenson / Pike (KY), VA; no source found for its build, height or fate.

facts.status_note: Forest Fire Lookout Association lists it as Gone with an unknown type; no other source describes the lookout

evidence.supports: Association lists Skeetrock, county Dickenson / Pike (KY), type Unknown, status Gone, at 37.26007 -82.38343
Community: unincorporated, in Dickenson County, near the Kentucky border
evidence.quote: Skeetrock is an unincorporated community in Dickenson County, Virginia, United States, situated along the mountainous terrain of the Appalachian region near the Kentucky border.
A post office was established at Skeetrock in 1901, and remained in operation until it was discontinued in 1958.

evidence.supports: Name origin: locals skated on the creek bed
evidence.quote: Skeetrock was so named because locals would skate, or skeet, on the slippery creek bed.

evidence.supports: Community coordinates 37.22194 N, 82.41389 W, southwest of the association point

notes_for_editor: Thin record. The only lookout data is one line in the association's Virginia list (county Dickenson / Pike (KY), type Unknown, Gone). Two web searches and a few page reads found no register entry, news item or heritage record for this tower. Wikipedia covers only the community of the same name and does not mention a lookout. The story is about 99 words, under the 120-word floor; it is honest about what is missing and the editor may prefer to hold it. The story says the point lies northeast of the community's coordinates; the two sources were not checked against each other for the tower's identity. No photo added.
